applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"
---

# Documentation Writing Rules

## Structure

- One concept per file
- Number files sequentially (001, 002, ...)
- Use H1 for the document title, H2 for sections,
  H3 for subsections
- No deeper than H3

## Writing Style

- Plain language. No marketing copy
- Be opinionated. Take a position, defend it
- Brief paragraphs. If a paragraph exceeds 5 lines,
  split it
- No filler phrases: "it should be noted that",
  "it is important to", "in order to"
- Use "this repository" or be specific (e.g.,
  "this document", "this practice") rather than
  repeating "AI-Driven Development"

## Content Rules

- Replace outdated content. Do not append history
  or changelog sections
- Every recommendation must have a clear position.
  If you cannot take a position, the section is not
  ready
- Keep the document short enough to read in one
  sitting
- Cross-reference other docs by relative link, not
  by repeating content

## Formatting

- Wrap lines at 50-60 characters for readability
  in plain text and diffs
- Use fenced code blocks with language tags
- Tables: use only when comparing structured data
- Lists: prefer flat lists over nested lists
